const axes: number[] = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < pad.axes.length; i++) axes.push(pad.axes[i] ?? 0);
replace: const axes: number[] = pad.axes as number[];
killedBy: readPadDiagnostics copies the live axis and button arrays instead of retaining the browser’s own
why: A real `Gamepad` object is re-read each frame, so a retained reference is a snapshot of nothing in particular. It is also how a live readout silently stops updating: the pane would redraw the same array object forever and show a stick that never moves, which is the one failure mode this feature exists to rule out.
